answer.rationale: Rollback is off the table because the release carries a compliance-mandated security patch, so memory_b1's playbook is unavailable. The degradation is on the write path during the daily settlement peak, which points to capacity exhaustion rather than a dependency failure (no partner outage signal, so circuit breakers are a poor fit) or read load (read replicas won't help write-path p99). Regional failover is high-risk during peak writes and doesn't address a capacity root cause. Adding capacity matches memory_b3's verified pattern of provisioning headroom absorbing peak load, and I want b3's archived record confirmed before committing my single intervention. Risk flagged: if the new release itself introduced a write-path regression, added capacity may only mask it partially; monitoring must continue after scaling.
